scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait db && concurrently -n api,web,hub -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:hub"
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -e .env.example -- nodemon --watch backend --ext go,sql --exec "go run -C backend ./cmd/api"
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U fuzion -d fuzion -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < backend/seed/dev_seed.sql
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:hub
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix hub install
